detail.longDescription: I was curious about what classifiers could do. It turns out, a lot, sometimes even play Doom. Jeffy is currently a collection of simple classifiers that can do spam detection, intent routing, topic classification, sentiment analysis and even play Doom Jeffy works locally on a regular computer, no GPU needed. It comes with 13 already-trained classifiers, and you can also use Jeffy to train your own classifiers And there’s a lot that can be built on top of this style of architecture Curious what tasks people find useful, and what architectures you are using for similar tasks
